exact_claim: For a retained characteristic-zero chart satisfying the listed geometric hypotheses and a fixed nonzero clearing factor g, a finite principal-open cover of the smooth normalization base admits eta=sum_j D_j(g t_j eta) in generic middle relative de Rham cohomology, with t_j in R and regular base coefficients of a fixed bounded ordinary differential order.
hypotheses: R is a normal integral finite-type complex algebra of dimension n.
h:Z->Spec R is projective, dominant, and equidimensional of relative dimension n; Z is smooth and integral of dimension 2n.
h_*O_Z=O_Spec R and a nowhere-zero volume form sigma_Z trivializes omega_Z.
mu:Spec R->A^n_C is finite dominant; a nonzero discriminant gives a finite etale free locus of rank e_mu over which h is smooth.
a=mu h is projective between smooth complex algebraic varieties, with the constant polarizable pure Hodge-module input.
The right-module top-form filtration starts at -2n; projective strictness and strict-support decomposition have their source-stated conventions.
The full-support generic variation is a smooth proper algebraic direct image, so Deligne's category hypotheses and monodromy semisimplicity apply.
g is a fixed nonzero element of R; eta=sigma_Z/du is interpreted on the generic smooth family.

For the characteristic-p application only: the chart, ordinary-operator expressions, coefficient denominator units, principal cover, nonzero etale discriminant, and de Rham/connection identities are retained, with perfect k and p>o_g.
result_class: Conditional source-mediated geometric differential-operator lemma, obtained by instantiating known Hodge-module and algebraic monodromy results; not certification of chart construction or global manuscript consequences.
supported_scope: The lowest Spencer filtration is Ra_*omega_Z, and strictness identifies its degree-zero cohomology with F_-2n H^0(a_+omega_Z).
Torsion-freeness removes proper-support lowest-filtration summands; algebraic semisimplicity forces D_P(R eta)=D_P(g R eta).
Local denominator absorption gives t_j in R and operators with regular coefficients on a finite principal cover.
On D(f) containing mu(b), k[u]_f embeds in R_b and is stable under coordinate derivatives; stability of the singular chart ring itself is unnecessary.
Under retained etale/separable reduction data, u is a p-basis of K_0=Frac R and the finite ordinary differential identity can be used in the selected fiber.
unsupported_scope: Independent proof that every earlier normalized chart has the smooth integral source, volume form, projectivity, equidimensionality, and h_*O_Z=R used here.
Independent certification of a common reduction model preserving these data and of arbitrarily large good fibers with nonzero Cartier scalar delta.
An extension of the relative frame across singular fibers, a positive-characteristic Hodge-module theorem, ordinary coefficient base change, or the full projective-space base theorem.
